technical.summary: Bullish short-term momentum with EMA golden cross and hull flip, but overbought conditions and weak ADX trend strength limit conviction; suitable for swing entry with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: LDOS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 74 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling pressure combined with extreme market fear (25/100) presents a contrarian buy opportunity, though lack of recent news data limits conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (375.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 74 days adds moderate event risk; macro_score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA golden cross + hull flip + three white soldiers provide short-term momentum confirmation in extreme fear conditions (VIX 375.2), offering contrarian entry near support at 83.95.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental score of 2, zero smart money conviction, overbought oscillators, weak ADX trend (23.25), price below 200-EMA, unfavourable macro, and 74-day earnings event risk overwhelm technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (EMA golden cross, hull flip) offers short-term entry signal at support in extreme fear conditions. However, fundamental vacuum (score 2), zero smart money conviction, and overbought oscillators with weak trend confirmation (ADX 23.25) create asymmetric risk.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 74 days combined with unfavourable macro (VIX crisis, macro_score -1) and price below 200-EMA creates high probability of mean reversion before technical setup matures.
